class FleetQuotaPayload(TypedDict):
    """Transient fleet quota JSON; owner sections retain their existing types.

    Null ledger adjuncts and unavailableSections are evidence, not routing policy.
    """

    identityPools: dict[str, Any]
    reserveFloors: dict[str, "ReserveFloor"]
    workerOutcomes24h: list[dict[str, Any]] | dict[str, Any]
    providerStatuses: list[dict[str, Any]]
    brokerAuth: dict[str, Any]
    probeDaemonHeartbeat: dict[str, Any]
    lastProbeAt: str | None
    suspendedLaunchRequests: list[dict[str, Any]] | None
    dismissedLaunchRequestCount: int | None
    quotaExhaustionEvents24h: dict[str, int | None]
    providerReportedQuotaHolds24h: dict[str, Any] | None
    estRemaining: dict[str, Any] | None
    unavailableSections: NotRequired[dict[str, Any]]
